source_of_truth: Operator complaint: the Architecture tab assigned a deterministic, no-creds regen command to a human. DontPanic should refresh the architecture map itself, regularly and after commits, for every project it tracks. Chosen approach (operator): cache-only-for-display regen-on-build (no tracked-repo mutation) + pre-commit hook for the committed copy.
completion_test: A tracked project with a missing or stale architecture map renders a current map in the Architecture tab with NO human 'run regen' card: the dashboard build self-heals it into the cache (F001), the serve refreshes when the snapshot changes (F002), and committing in a tracked repo keeps the committed map fresh via an auto-installed hook (F003). The dashboard build never writes into a tracked repo's working tree.
non_goals: Writing architecture.json into tracked repos during a DontPanic dashboard build (rejected: surprises git status).
Registering DontPanic itself as a tracked project (separate operator decision).

user_journeys.name: missing-map-self-heals
user_journeys.description: Operator opens the Architecture tab for a tracked project whose map was never generated; the dashboard build has already regenerated it into the cache, so the tab renders a current map with no 'run regen' card.

user_journeys.name: commit-keeps-map-fresh
user_journeys.description: Operator commits architecture-relevant changes in a tracked repo; the auto-installed pre-commit hook regenerates + stages docs/architecture/architecture.json so the committed map never drifts (F003).
